missing: A clear guide to which third-party panels work with the Outdoor 4, with compared prices, wattage, cable length, tested charging results, and a warning that Blink's own panel mount does not fit the Outdoor 4. The sources contradict each other on this: Best Buy's Q&A says the Blink mount is compatible, while Blink support says it is not.
why: No major reviewer or authority tests Outdoor 4 solar panels. Blink's support pages only say its own mount does not fit, and the rest are single-seller listings, a deal post and a launch roundup. Best Buy's Q&A answer contradicts Blink support. A focused page comparing third-party panels with current prices and a clear compatibility answer would stand out.
